findings.label: Missing animate-pulse-ring class
findings.description: The CSS class animate-pulse-ring applied to PENDING order wrappers in ServeurDashboard is defined nowhere (not in index.css, not in tailwind.config.js). The pulsing ring animation for new orders never fires. Add a @keyframes rule and animation utility in index.css or via tailwind.config.js theme.extend.keyframes/animation.

findings.label: validatedAt overwritten at prep start
findings.description: TicketCard.handleStart writes validatedAt: Timestamp.now() to anchor the countdown, clobbering the timestamp written by OrderActions.handleValidate (the waiter's approval time). Add a dedicated prepStartedAt?: Timestamp field to the Order type in src/types/index.ts, write prepStartedAt in handleStart, and update the countdown useEffect to read order.prepStartedAt.

findings.label: orderCount never incremented
findings.description: OrderActions.handleValidate does not call incrementProductOrderCount. The orderCount field that drives most-popular ranking in the menu never updates through the waiter flow. Call incrementProductOrderCount for each item in order.items after successfully setting status to VALIDATED.

findings.label: Hardcoded Tables heading
findings.description: ServeurDashboard line 151 renders the string 'Tables' as a hardcoded JSX literal. Add a translation key (e.g. table.section_title) to both fr.json and en.json and replace the literal.

findings.label: Catch-all maps every failure to wrong-credentials message
findings.description: LoginPage.handleSubmit catches all errors (wrong credentials, network failure, missing Firestore user document) and shows auth.error_invalid. The thrown Error('no_user_doc') is distinguishable; branch on it in the catch block and show auth.error_generic for non-credential errors.

findings.label: Logout buttons missing aria-label
findings.description: The logout buttons in ServeurDashboard and CuisineDashboard render translated text but have no explicit aria-label attribute. Add aria-label={t('nav.logout')} to both.
